priorityList: Use Tiger's Fury on cooldown, especially before spending energy or refreshing bleeds.
Use Regrowth with Predatory Swiftness procs to trigger Wildstalker passive benefits.
Cast Chomp whenever the Chomp Enabler buff is active.
Use Ferocious Bite immediately when Apex Predator's Craving procs.
At 5 Combo Points, use Primal Wrath if the bleed is missing or in the refresh window (under 6.5s).
Use Ferocious Bite at 4+ Combo Points if Ravage is active, or if Rampant Ferocity is talented and Primal Wrath is already ticking.
At 5 Combo Points, use Primal Wrath as your default finisher to maintain AoE pressure.
Use Berserk or Incarnation only when Tiger's Fury is active.
Use Feral Frenzy or Frantic Frenzy when at 2 or fewer Combo Points while Tiger's Fury is active.
Cast Convoke the Spirits during Berserk or Tiger's Fury, ideally immediately following a Finisher.
Apply and maintain Rake on as many targets as possible (up to 5) to spread bleeds.
Maintain Moonfire on targets if talented into Lunar Inspiration.
Use Swipe as your primary builder when 3 or more targets are present.
Use Shred as your builder on exactly 2 targets if talented into Panther's Guile.
Use damage-dealing trinkets and combat potions during your Berserk or Incarnation window.
